title: Kynvera confirmation prompts
note: Standalone catalog of every confirmation dialog. Sample names are placeholders. Regenerated by scripts/build_confirmation_prompt_catalog.py.

prompts.title: Deactivate account?
prompts.message: Arshith Swaminath P will not be able to sign in until you activate this account again.

prompts.title: Activate account?
prompts.message: Arshith Swaminath P will be able to sign in again.

prompts.title: Reset password?
prompts.message: Reset the password for demo? The temporary password will be shown next.

prompts.title: Delete user?
prompts.message: Are you sure you want to delete user "demo"? This action cannot be undone.

prompts.title: Close this form?
prompts.message: Close this form? It will become read-only for all users.

prompts.title: Close documents?
prompts.message: Close 3 document(s)? They will become read-only for all users.

prompts.title: Remove this device?
prompts.message: Remove this device?

prompts.title: Delete knowledge article?
prompts.message: Delete "Leave policy"? This cannot be undone.

prompts.title: Delete this project?
prompts.message: Delete this project and all its steps?

prompts.title: Download a copy?
prompts.message: This downloads the database this website is using right now. It does not include Excel reports, PDFs, photos, or Google Drive files.

prompts.title: Delete Technician
prompts.message: Are you sure you want to permanently delete Arshith Swaminath P? This action cannot be undone.

prompts.title: Session expired?
prompts.message: Session expired. Would you like to log in again?

prompts.title: A new version is available
prompts.message: A new version of Kynvera is available. Reload to update?

prompts.title: Delete candidate
prompts.message: Delete this candidate and all uploaded documents? This cannot be undone.

prompts.title: Application has been closed
prompts.message: This hiring file was marked not hired. Reopen it to continue the process?

prompts.title: Already hired
prompts.message: This person has already been hired, so Put on hold and Not hired are not enabled. Ask for approval if you need to use those options.

prompts.title: Unassign vacancy
prompts.message: Remove this candidate from the project vacancy? The vacancy stays open in Manpower Tracker.

prompts.title: Clear upload mark
prompts.message: Clear the in-person file uploaded mark for this document?

prompts.title: Clear document
prompts.message: Clear this document? The uploaded file will be removed.

prompts.title: Mark all submitted
prompts.message: Mark every document as submitted? Existing uploaded files are kept. PCC will be marked attested.

prompts.title: Apply Excel import?
prompts.message: Review what will change before applying this workbook to the candidate list.

prompts.title: Delete this letter of intent?
prompts.message: Delete this letter of intent and its files? The hiring candidate is not deleted.

prompts.title: Reduce headcount
prompts.message: Remove 2 vacancy rows from the main table for this trade × project? Empty open rows are removed first.

prompts.title: Remove trade
prompts.message: Remove "Electrician" from dropdowns and the Excel Lists sheet? 3 linked vacancies stay on the board.

prompts.title: Remove project
prompts.message: Remove "Askaan Saqr" from dropdowns and the Excel Lists sheet? 1 linked vacancy stays on the board.

prompts.title: Delete vacancy
prompts.message: Delete this vacancy? This cannot be undone.

prompts.title: Unlink hiring candidate
prompts.message: Remove the Hiring Docs link? Name and contact stay on this vacancy as text.

prompts.title: Candidate is on hold
prompts.message: Arshith Swaminath P is On hold in Hiring Docs. Do you still want to add them to Askaan Saqr?

prompts.title: Switch project?
prompts.message: Arshith Swaminath P is marked Candidate employed and assigned to Marina Walk. Do you agree to switch them to Askaan Saqr?

prompts.title: Link employed candidate?
prompts.message: Arshith Swaminath P is marked Candidate employed. Link them to Askaan Saqr anyway?

prompts.title: Seed staff
prompts.message:
Load staff from the bundled July 2026 staff list?

Existing Emp IDs are skipped.

Tip: Shift+click to upload a different staff Excel instead.

prompts.title: Delete leave log
prompts.message: Delete this leave log? Staff master totals will update.

prompts.title: Delete leave plan
prompts.message: Delete this leave plan?

prompts.title: Apply leave plan
prompts.message: Create leave logs from this plan (days split by month) and update the staff master?

prompts.title: Reset the form?
prompts.message: Reset the form?

prompts.title: Delete file?
prompts.message: Delete "Site photo.jpg"? This removes it from Files and from Google Drive.

prompts.title: Delete folder?
prompts.message: Delete folder "HR documents" and everything inside it? Synced copies will also be removed from Google Drive.

prompts.title: Disconnect Google Drive?
prompts.message: This stops Drive sync for this organization. Local Files stay available.

prompts.title: Withdraw this HR request?
prompts.message:
Your reporting manager will be notified.
This cannot be undone from this page.

prompts.title: Delete this draft?
prompts.message:
This permanently removes the draft.
This action cannot be undone.

prompts.title: Remove entry?
prompts.message: This manpower line will be removed from the ticket.

prompts.title: Remove material?
prompts.message: This material will be removed from the ticket. Catalog stock is returned if it was taken from inventory.

prompts.title: Put Ticket On Hold
prompts.message: Select a reason to place this ticket on hold. Notes are optional.

prompts.title: Cancel Ticket
prompts.message: This action cancels the ticket. You can reopen it later if needed.

prompts.title: Discard this draft?
prompts.message: Discard this draft? It will be marked cancelled and will not become an active ticket.

prompts.title: Remove this project?
prompts.message: Remove this project?

prompts.title: Delete this template?
prompts.message: Delete this template?

prompts.title: Delete this property?
prompts.message: Delete this property and all its children?

prompts.title: Delete this location?
prompts.message: Delete this zone?

prompts.title: Send for approval?
prompts.message: The general manager and system administrator will be notified. They open this purchase request to approve a quotation and the request. The stamped PDF appears only after that.

prompts.title: Reject this request?
prompts.message: The requester will be notified with your reason.

prompts.title: Remove material
prompts.message: Remove HVAC Filter from Askaan Saqr? Only this site’s stock is deleted.

prompts.title: Reset this email?
prompts.message: Subject and body go back to the standard wording. To and CC are cleared. Attach PDF is turned on.

prompts.title: Delete catalog item?
prompts.message:
Delete "HVAC Filter"?

This cannot be undone.

prompts.title: Photos failed to upload
prompts.message:
⚠️ 2 photo(s) failed to upload.

Do you want to add this item without them?

Click "Retry All Failed" to try uploading them again.

prompts.title: Failed to upload
prompts.message: Failed to upload site-photo.jpg. Continue anyway?

prompts.title: Clear all items?
prompts.message: Clear all items? (Photos already uploaded to cloud will remain there)

prompts.title: Remove this item?
prompts.message: Remove this item? (Photos remain in cloud storage)

prompts.title: Submit with 0 items?
prompts.message: Warning: You are submitting a report with 0 items. Are you sure?

prompts.title: Discard unsaved changes?
prompts.message: Discard unsaved changes?

prompts.message: Delete this document?

prompts.title: Delete this contact?
prompts.message: Delete this contact?

prompts.title: Delete this project?
prompts.message: Delete this project? Quotations stay on file but are unlinked from the deal.

prompts.title: Mark this deal as won?
prompts.message: Mark this deal as won and promote to ticketing?

prompts.message: Delete this automation?

prompts.message: Cancel this session?

prompts.message: Clear all imported compliance data? Dashboard counts will reset until you import again.

prompts.message: Stop automation? This will disable the daily schedule immediately. You can re-enable it anytime from the Email Report section.
